Year.description: The tax year for which the e-file is being processed. Must be a valid 4-digit year (e.g., 2024).

TaxType.description: Specifies the type of tax return being processed. 1040, 1041, 1065, 1120, 990, 5500, 709.

TaxReturnID.description: A 6-digit unique alphanumeric identifier for the specific tax return. This is also referred to as the Locator ID.

Jurisdiction.description: The state or local jurisdiction code where the tax is being filed. Example: AL for Alabama. Use the /v2/e-file-jurisdictions endpoint to retrieve valid codes.

EFileRequestType.description: Indicates the type of e-file request. This value is predefined for each jurisdiction. Example: REG, REG2. Use the /v2/e-file-jurisdictions endpoint to retrieve valid request types for each jurisdiction.
